newsitem.title: UK: NFC says market conditions still challenging.
newsitem.headline: NFC says market conditions still challenging.

text.p: British distribution group NFC Plc said on Wednesday that market conditions remained challenging, although it added that it expected to make progress this year.
The company said conditions were especially challenging in Europe, where its business had been affected by drivers' strikes in France and Spain.
"Nevertheless, the board continues to expect that the group will make further progress during the year," chairman Sir Christopher Bland said in a statement from the company's annual general meeting.
NFC shares gained 4.5p to 157 by 1255 GMT.
